unlocks.summary: Centrifuge's docs (as of June 2026) describe vesting windows but no dated tranches: 100M CFG from the CP149 mint vesting linearly through April 2029, the team's 12% through May 2030, and other stakeholders' tokens over 22 months through March 2028.

schedules.label: CP149 mint (100M CFG)
schedules.basis: Of the 115M CFG minted under CP149, 15M unlocked at minting in May 2025 and the remaining 100M vest linearly through April 2029. The page gives no exact start or end day, so no monthly amount is shown.

schedules.label: Team (12% of supply)
schedules.basis: 12% of total supply is allocated to the Centrifuge team, vesting gradually through May 2030. No start date or cadence is given.

schedules.label: Other stakeholders
schedules.basis: The rest of the stakeholder allocation vests over 22 months through March 2028. The amount isn't stated.
